extName.message: GitLab MR Actions — Merge Request Automation, Jira, CI/CD & AI Review

extDescription.message: One-click GitLab merge request automation: auto-merge, version bump, Jira, CI/CD and review with your AI. No tokens needed.

openSettingsInTab.message: Open settings in a new tab

settingsTransferHint.message: Share all settings and project profiles as a JSON file.

settingsImportReplace.message: This replaces all current settings and project profiles.

settingsFileInvalid.message: Invalid settings file or unsupported format.

settingsFileTooLarge.message: The settings file exceeds Chrome Sync storage limits.

settingsExportFailed.message: Could not export settings. Please try again.

settingsImportFailed.message: Could not import settings. Your current configuration is unchanged.

settingsImportPermissionDenied.message: Allow access to the Jira site to import these settings.

buttonOrderHint.message: Drag to reorder. Hover for description. Custom jobs in blue.

showGroupByAuthor.message: "Group by author" toggle on list page

versionFieldHint.message: JSON key or TOML key (e.g. "version" or "tool.poetry.version")

quickCommentsHint.message: One-click buttons that instantly post a general comment to the MR (not inline to code). Buttons appear in the action bar.

cardQuickCommentsDesc.message: Configurable template comment buttons on MR page. Post LGTM, Needs fixes, or any custom comment with one click.

reviewersListHint.message: Usernames to assign as reviewers (@user1, @user2). If set — ignores comments and job.

jobNameHint.message: Fallback job if no comment matches "Reviewer(s):" pattern

customJobsHint.message: Use commas to chain: build, deploy

overrideHint.message: Override which buttons to show for this project.

projectSpecificJobs.message: Project-specific jobs. Use commas to chain.

hintVersion.message: Reads the configured file (e.g. package.json), increments version by chosen strategy (patch/minor/major), commits with your template message.

hintRebase.message: Rebases the source branch onto the target branch. Does not merge or enable auto-merge.

hintRebaseVersion.message: Rebases branch onto target (if needed), then bumps version in the configured file. Does not merge.

hintRebaseAutomerge.message: Rebases branch onto target (if project uses rebase/ff). Then enables "merge when pipeline succeeds". Uses squash/delete branch settings from MR.

hintRebaseForce.message: Rebases with skip CI, cancels all running pipelines, then merges immediately without waiting for CI. Uses squash/delete branch settings from MR.

hintShip.message: Full flow: rebase → bump version in configured file → wait for MR to sync → wait for new pipeline → enable auto-merge.

hintForceShip.message: Fast flow: rebase (skip CI) → bump version → wait 15s → cancel pipeline → merge immediately. Skips CI checks.

hintReviewers.message: Searches MR comments for "Reviewer(s):" pattern, reposts last match. If not found — triggers the configured pipeline job.

hintPipelineRestart.message: Creates a brand new pipeline for the source branch via API. Useful when pipeline is stuck or you need a fresh run.

hintPipelineCancel.message: Cancels all pipelines in running/pending/created state on this MR.

hintDraftToggle.message: Adds or removes "Draft:" prefix from MR title. Does not change any other MR settings.

hintRetryFailed.message: Finds all jobs with status "failed" in the latest pipeline and retries each one. Already succeeded jobs are not affected.

hintCopyMr.message: Copies the MR title and link to clipboard.

toastNoFailedJobs.message: No failed jobs in latest pipeline

toastWaitingSync.message: Waiting for MR to sync with v$1...

confirmNewPipeline.message: Create a new pipeline for this branch?

welcomeSubtitle.message: Speed up your merge request workflow with one-click actions.

welcomeStep1Desc.message: Navigate to any MR on your GitLab instance (self-hosted or gitlab.com)

welcomeStep2Desc.message: Buttons will show at the bottom of the MR widget area. We enabled the most popular ones for you.

welcomeStep3Desc.message: Click the extension icon to enable/disable buttons, set version bump file, add custom job buttons, and more.

welcomeHowDesc.message: This extension uses your existing GitLab session (cookies) to call the GitLab API on your behalf. No personal access tokens needed.

welcomeHowList1.message: Works with any self-hosted GitLab instance and gitlab.com

welcomeHowList2.message: Actions use the same permissions as your logged-in user

welcomeHowList3.message: Long-running job chains run in the background and survive page navigation

welcomeHowList4.message: Per-project profiles let you customize buttons for different repositories

welcomeTip.message: You can create per-project profiles in the popup settings. This is useful when different projects need different version files or custom CI jobs.

cardAutomergeDesc.message: Rebase the branch (if needed) and enable merge when pipeline succeeds.

cardNewPipelineDesc.message: Create a fresh pipeline for the source branch with one click.

cardCancelPipelineDesc.message: Cancel all running pipelines on the MR instantly.

cardDraftToggleDesc.message: Switch MR between Draft and Ready status without editing the title.

cardVersionBumpDesc.message: Increment version in package.json, pyproject.toml, or any custom file. Configurable strategy (patch/minor/major).

cardShipDesc.message: Bump version, wait for pipeline, auto-merge. Full release flow in one click.

cardForceMergeDesc.message: Skip pipeline and merge immediately. Use with caution.

cardReviewersDesc.message: Repost last reviewer assignment comment or trigger a reviewer pipeline job.

hideRightSidebar.message: Hide right sidebar on MR pages

cardCollapseDesc.message: Adds a button to collapse/expand GitLab navigation bars. Saves space and helps you focus on content.

cardHideSectionsDesc.message: Hide right sidebar on MR pages to get full-width content area.

jiraUrlHint.message: e.g. https://jira.company.com — grant permission when prompted, no tokens needed

jiraTicketRegexHint.message: Custom regex for parsing ticket IDs from MR titles. Default: [A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-\d+

showJiraDetails.message: Show issue type & priority icons on MR list

jiraQuickActionsHint.message: Choose any combination of fields for each button. Leave only the changes it should make. Versions and components must already exist in the Jira project.

cardJiraDesc.message: Shows Jira ticket statuses on the MR list page. Parses ticket IDs from MR titles (e.g. CCT-1111) and displays colored status badges. Set your Jira URL in settings.

cardJiraRegexDesc.message: Configure a custom regular expression for parsing Jira ticket IDs from MR titles. Useful when your project uses non-standard ticket prefixes.

cardJiraSidebarDesc.message: Click any Jira badge to open a sidebar with full ticket details — summary, status, type, priority, assignee, and description. Read, post, and delete your own comments without leaving GitLab. Fix versions can be picked from the project's available versions directly in the sidebar.

cardJiraAttachmentsDesc.message: View images, videos, and files from Jira tickets directly in the sidebar. Images and videos open in a fullscreen lightbox.

cardJiraDetailDesc.message: Jira ticket status badges are shown in the MR title on the detail page. Click a badge to open the sidebar with full ticket details.

cardJiraStatusChangeDesc.message: Change ticket status directly from the sidebar. Shows only available transitions from the current status.

cardJiraAssigneeDesc.message: Click the assignee to search and reassign. Autocomplete with avatars, unassign button to remove assignee.

cardJiraQuickActionsDesc.message: One-click buttons for status, assignee, labels, versions and other fields. Each button can update one field or several.

cardJiraDetailsDesc.message: Show Jira issue type and priority icons next to status badges on MR list and detail pages. Uses native Jira icons.

cardRebaseDesc.message: Rebase the source branch onto the target branch without merging.

cardRebaseVersionDesc.message: Rebase the branch and bump version in one click. Does not merge.

cardCopyMrDesc.message: Copy the MR title and link to clipboard with one click.

cardRetryFailedDesc.message: Retry all failed jobs in the latest pipeline. Already succeeded jobs are not affected.

cardDimDraftsDesc.message: Visually dim Draft MRs on the merge requests list page so you can focus on active ones.

cardHighlightOwnDesc.message: Highlight your own MRs in the list with a blue border for quick identification.

cardOnlyMineDesc.message: One-click toggle to filter the MR list to show only your merge requests.

cardMrAgeDesc.message: Shows how long ago the MR was created, displayed as a badge on the MR page.

badgeYourReviewHint.message: You are mentioned as reviewer in MR comments

cardReviewerBadgeDesc.message: Scans first 10 comments for "Reviewer(s): @you" pattern and shows a badge if you are assigned. Separate from GitLab's built-in reviewer feature.

showNeedsReview.message: "Needs my review" toggle on list page

cardNeedsReviewDesc.message: One-click toggle to filter the MR list to show only merge requests where you are assigned as a reviewer.

showCopyMr.message: Copy button on MR list items

showThreadsBadge.message: Unresolved threads count on MR list

showSizeBadge.message: MR size labels (S/M/L/XL) on MR list

showConflictsBadge.message: Show conflicts indicator on MR list

showApprovalBadge.message: Show approval count and my approval indicator on MR list

cardThreadsDesc.message: Shows a red badge with the number of unresolved discussion threads on each MR in the list.

cardSizeDesc.message: Color-coded size badges (S/M/L/XL) based on the number of changed lines. S: 1-50, M: 51-200, L: 201-500, XL: 500+.

conflictsBadgeHint.message: This MR has merge conflicts that must be resolved

cardConflictsDesc.message: Shows a red CONFLICTS badge on MR detail page when the branch has merge conflicts.

cardApprovalDesc.message: Shows whether you have approved each MR on the list page. Distinguishes your approval from approvals by others.

showBranches.message: Show source and target branches on MR list

showBranchesLinks.message: Make branch names clickable (open branch tree)

cardBranchesDesc.message: Displays source and target branch names on each MR in the list, so you can see where the code is coming from and where it merges into.

cardCopyMrListDesc.message: Adds a copy button to each MR on the list page. Copies the MR title and link to clipboard with one click.

versionFromTargetHint.message: Read current version from the target branch (e.g. main) instead of the source branch. Use this with merge commit strategy to avoid stale versions.

showFailedJobView.message: Show failed job quick view on MR page

cardFailedJobViewDesc.message: When a pipeline fails, shows failed job names and last lines of the error log directly on the MR page. No need to click through to find the error.

standupJiraEnrich.message: Show Jira ticket titles in report

cardCmdPaletteDesc.message: Press Cmd+K (Mac) or Ctrl+K (Win) on any GitLab page. Navigate, run MR actions, search files by name and open them in the repo.

cardStandupDesc.message: Generate a daily activity report from your GitLab data. Shows created, merged, and reviewed MRs. Copy and paste into Slack or Jira.

showGroupPlay.message: Group play button in pipeline (runs remaining manual jobs)

showCommitVersionHint.message: Shows the version from the version file (see Version bump settings) next to each commit; highlighted where the version changed

groupPlayTooltip.message: Run remaining manual jobs in this group

cardGroupPlayDesc.message: On the pipeline graph, a play button next to a job group runs all remaining manual jobs — even after some jobs in the group have already started and GitLab's own button disappears.

cardCommitVersionDesc.message: On the branch commits page, each commit shows the project version from your version file at that commit. Muted by default, highlighted where the version changed — see at a glance which commits went into which release.

cherryPickBranchesHint.message: Default target branches for cherry-pick. You can add or remove branches in the modal.

cherryPickCreateMr.message: Start a new merge request with these changes

cherryPickCreateMrDefault.message: Create MR by default when cherry-picking

cherryPickSmartFallback.message: On conflict — commit without version file

cherryPickSmartFallbackHint.message: If cherry-pick fails due to version file conflict, replay changes as a new commit excluding the version file

cherryPickBumpVersionHint.message: Bump version in the target branch within the same fallback commit

cherryPickFallbackNoVersionFile.message: Smart fallback only handles version file conflicts. The conflict is in another file

cherryPickFallbackDiverged.message: File was modified in target branch — cannot safely cherry-pick

cherryPickFallbackVersionFileHasOtherCha.message: Version file contains changes beyond version — cannot safely skip it

commitsJiraFieldHint.message: Jira field name to show as badges on commits page (e.g. fixVersions, status, labels, components). Requires Jira URL.

cardCherryPickDesc.message: Cherry-pick any commit to multiple branches at once with real-time status. If a cherry-pick fails due to a version file conflict, the extension automatically retries — it replays the commit without the version file and optionally bumps the version, all in a single commit preserving the original author. Jira badges next to each commit open the full ticket sidebar.

cardSensitiveDesc.message: Shows a warning badge when the MR modifies security-sensitive files like .env, Dockerfile, CI configs, or credential files.

cardGitCommandsDesc.message: Copy ready-to-run checkout, pull, and hard-reset git commands for the MR's source branch with one click. Useful for local testing.

updateBannerText.message: New version is available! See what's new:

aiReviewFeatureDesc.message: Review an MR, fix selected feedback, prepare replies and recheck changes. Preview and edit comments before posting to GitLab.

aiReviewPrivacyHint.message: No automatic AI uploads. Copy the context yourself; comments are sent to GitLab only when you choose Publish or Add to review.

aiReviewConfirmCloseSetting.message: Confirm closing review dialogs with unsaved work

aiReviewConfirmDiscard.message: Close this dialog? Unsaved edits and entered data will be lost.

aiReviewConfirmStopAndClose.message: Close this dialog and stop further sending? Comments already sent will remain in GitLab. Unsaved edits will be lost.

aiReviewIncludeCodeHint.message: For fresh and repeat reviews. Leave off if the AI can read the repository. Short excerpts attached to feedback remain included.

aiReviewCopyFailed.message: Could not copy automatically. Select and copy the preview manually.

aiReviewPartial.message: Some data could not be loaded. The export includes a warning and only the available context.

aiReviewManualCopy.message: Select the preview text and copy it manually.

aiReviewLoadFailed.message: Could not load discussions. Retry, or copy the available context.

showAiReviewCopy.message: Show AI review copy and import controls

aiReviewSettingsHint.message: Copy the whole MR for a fresh review, selected feedback for fixes, or import AI comments and replies with an editable preview before sending.

aiReviewFreshPromptHint.message: Up to 1,500 characters. Used to review the whole MR and all its commits, separately from feedback fixes. You can specify the response language. Leave blank for the default English prompt.

aiReviewFreshHint.message: Review all MR commits together. The AI returns new findings without changing code.

aiReviewPromptHint.message: Up to 1,500 characters. Leave blank to use the default English prompt. Applies to all projects.

aiReviewPromptTooLong.message: Prompt not saved. Use at most 1,500 characters and remove unusual control characters.

settingsSaveFailed.message: Settings could not be saved. Make a change to retry.

aiReviewPromptSessionHint.message: Changes here apply to this export. Set your default prompt in extension settings.

aiReviewLoadHint.message: Loads discussions directly from GitLab, including comments not visible on this page.

aiReviewCommentContext.message: Other replies are included as context. Only selected comments are requested for action.

aiReviewNoteUnavailable.message: This comment is not available from GitLab. It may still be saving or may have been removed. Refresh to try again.

aiReviewCopyPromptsHint.message: Copy the task into your AI tool. If it returns comments or replies, use Paste AI response to review and edit them before posting.

aiReviewImportHelp.message: Paste the AI response below to check, edit and choose what to publish. Prompt shortcuts are under Advanced settings.

aiReviewImportPromptReady.message: Prompt ready. Copy it into your AI assistant.

aiReviewImportInputHint.message: Paste the complete JSON response containing new comments or replies to discussions. You can edit the text and choose what to send in the preview.

aiReviewImportChecking.message: Checking the MR revision, lines, and existing comments…

aiReviewImportEmpty.message: Check the response to preview comments. You can edit their text, clear checkboxes to exclude items, or add a general comment.

aiReviewImportDiffRecoveryFailed.message: Additional file changes could not be loaded: $error$

aiReviewImportDiffResponseTooLarge.message: The additional diff exceeds the 16 MiB import limit. Only comments on verified lines can be imported.

aiReviewImportSendHint.message: Publish sends comments immediately. Add to review saves unpublished comments for your GitLab review.

aiReviewImportFinished.message: Finished. Check the result beside each comment.

aiReviewImportStopped.message: Stopped. Check the result beside each comment before retrying.

aiReviewImportEdited.message: Response changed. Check it again before sending.

aiReviewImportCopyFailed.message: Clipboard unavailable. Select the text below and copy it manually.

aiReviewImportUnsafeRetry.message: Delivery could not be confirmed. Check GitLab before retrying.

aiReviewResponseLanguageHint.message: Applies to all review tasks and import prompts. JSON keys, paths and code are not translated. Copying the format alone does not add language instructions.

aiReviewImportPromptSettingHint.message: Up to 1500 characters. For the new-review shortcut in Import. Task tabs use their own prompts. MR context and the JSON format are added automatically.

aiReviewReplyPromptSettingHint.message: Up to 1500 characters. For replies to selected discussions in Copy or all unresolved discussions in Import. Set style and language; context and the reply format are added automatically.

aiReviewImportCopyAllReplyPrompt.message: Reply prompt for all unresolved discussions

aiReviewImportResolveFailed.message: Reply published, but the discussion was not resolved. You can resolve it in GitLab.

aiReviewImportResolveUnknown.message: Reply published. Resolution was not confirmed; check the discussion in GitLab.

aiReviewImportReplyHint.message: Resolution is optional and off by default. It runs only after publishing the reply. Adding a draft never resolves a discussion.

aiReviewReplyVersionChanged.message: The MR version has changed. Replies remain linked to their discussions; verify their text against the pushed fixes. New findings from an old revision are blocked.

aiReviewReplyVerifyPushed.message: These replies are linked to discussions, not a code revision. Before publishing, verify that the described fixes have been pushed to this MR.

aiReviewImportEditingHint.message: Edit the text, then save it to check the changes before publishing.

aiReviewImportCommentLimit.message: The preview can contain at most 200 comments.

aiReviewFileFiltersHint.message: Applies to fresh and repeat reviews and new-finding prompts, not selected feedback or reply prompts. One pattern per line or comma; # starts a comment. Use *, **, ?. Exclusions win, including old rename paths. Empty lists include everything. Example: src/**, *.test.js, dist/. Up to 1500 characters per list.

aiReviewFilterInvalid.message: File filters could not be saved or applied. Use at most 1500 characters per list and remove unusual control characters.

aiReviewPreviousSha.message: Enter the full reviewed commit SHA (40 or 64 hexadecimal characters)

aiReviewPreviousHint.message: Select the MR version you reviewed before leaving your comments. All subsequent changes up to the current version are included automatically; you do not need to select individual commits. If you do not remember the version, choose a full review.

aiReviewTaskReviewHint.message: Review all MR commits together. The AI returns new findings without changing code.

aiReviewTaskFixHint.message: Select feedback to fix. For an MR, the AI also prepares replies explaining what was done, what remains and why. Unresolved discussions are selected initially.

aiReviewTaskFixOnlyHint.message: Select feedback for your coding AI to fix. Unresolved discussions are selected initially.

aiReviewNextFixOnlyStep.message: Give the task to your coding AI and check its changes and tests. The result is fixes and a normal summary, without ready-to-post replies.

aiReviewTaskReplyHint.message: After pushing fixes, ask the AI to verify the code and explain the result in selected discussions.

aiReviewTaskRepeatHint.message: Verify selected feedback and look for new defects. Choose the version you previously reviewed, or check the full current MR.

aiReviewSummaryFresh.message: Task: the whole MR, across all commits.

aiReviewSummaryFix.message: Selected comments: $1; discussion context and available code excerpts are included.

aiReviewSummaryReplies.message: Discussions for replies: $1, with their full conversation. The AI needs repository access.

aiReviewSummaryRepeat.message: Discussions to verify: $1, plus a review of code changes.

aiReviewSummaryCodeOn.message: Code changes included, subject to loading limits.

aiReviewSummaryCodeOff.message: The AI must read code from the repository.

aiReviewSummaryFullRepeat.message: No earlier version selected: the full current MR will be checked.

aiReviewSummaryDraftsExcluded.message: Unpublished draft discussions cannot receive replies and are excluded.

aiReviewChooseFeedback.message: Select feedback on the left. For a new review, use the New review tab.

aiReviewNextStep.message: Copy the task into your AI tool. If it returns comments or replies, use Paste AI response to review and edit them before posting.

aiReviewNextFixStep.message: Check the fixes and tests, push all commits to the MR, then use Paste AI response to review the prepared replies before posting. New commits do not require regenerating replies.

aiReviewAutomaticInstructionsHint.message: All blocks are enabled by default and used only for relevant tasks. Edit, disable or clear any block. Task prompts have their own instructions too. MR data, JSON examples and loading notices are generated separately; publication checks always apply.

aiReviewInstructionEnabled.message: Add to the task when applicable

aiReviewInstructionTextHint.message: Up to 1500 characters. Empty text adds nothing. Reset restores the default text and enables this block.

aiReviewLanguageTemplateHint.message: Use {language} for the selected response language. Up to 1500 characters; empty text adds nothing.

aiReviewSelectionTemplateHint.message: Use {selection} for selected or unresolved discussions. Up to 1500 characters; empty text adds nothing.

jiraQuickActionListHint.message: Values separated by commas. Add/remove keeps other values; replace all overwrites the list.

jiraQuickActionCustomHint.message: Field ID: customfield_12345. Enter the value as JSON in the format expected by this Jira field.

jiraQuickActionStatusHint.message: Exact Jira transition name (or target status).

jiraQuickActionInvalid.message: Check the field value: custom fields require a valid ID and JSON; dates use YYYY-MM-DD.

jiraQuickActionDuplicate.message: Use each field only once per button.

jiraQuickActionPartial.message: The status changed, but the field update failed.

jiraQuickActionRefreshFailed.message: Could not refresh the issue. Reopen the panel to check its current values.

mrActionsHint.message: Create named buttons to change labels or clear other MR fields. Drag them in the button list to change their order.

mrActionsProfileHint.message: This project uses its own action list after saving. Remove all entries to hide these buttons for this project.

mrActionLabelsHint.message: Exact label names, separated by commas or new lines. Spaces inside names are preserved. Add/replace may create missing project labels.

mrActionInvalid.message: Enter a button name, choose a supported action and specify at least one label for add, remove or replace.
